description: This is a React component source file that implements a client-side interactive Mind Map interface. It manages state, fetches data from APIs, handles user interactions such as filtering, node selection, and view controls, and renders various UI components like the map canvas, filters, and detail panels.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Provides default filtering parameters for the mind map.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Initializes the default view state of the mind map including position, zoom, filters, and selected node.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts a raw state object into a validated and sanitized MindmapViewState object.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Returns a stable user identifier based on persona ID or defaults to 'anonymous'.
